sponsoredBills.summary: The bill amends the Small Business Investment Act of 1958 to allow the Small Business Administration Administrator to increase loan guarantee commitments to qualified state or local development companies by up to 15 percent above statutory limits, with advance congressional notification required.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Financial Services, and in addition to the Committees on Ways and Means, and Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

sponsoredBills.summary: Increases the low-income housing tax credit ceiling, establishes loan funds and grant programs for middle-income and workforce rental housing construction, creates a housing accelerator program for gap financing, and increases funding for community development and HOME investment partnership programs.
sponsoredBills.title: Housing BOOM Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, and Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

sponsoredBills.summary: Expresses support for reproductive justice, affirming that every person has the right to safe conditions for childbirth and family formation, access to abortion and comprehensive reproductive health care, freedom from pregnancy criminalization, and conditions to raise families with dignity.
sponsoredBills.title: Expressing support for Reproductive Justice on the 250th Anniversary of the United States of America.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committee on Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

sponsoredBills.title: Safeguarding American Families and Expanding Social Security Act of 2026
